Marine Weather Statement issued July 30 at 1:51PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL.

The areas affected include Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm... Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 20-60 nm... At 1:50 PM Eastern Daylight Time, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm, capable of producing winds to around 30 knots.

This thunderstorm was located 8 nm east of Jupiter Island, moving east at 20 knots.
